sample_unit: shoulder x-rays (35 proximal humerus fracture, 35 normal)

links.outcome: ChatGPT-5 diagnostic accuracy for proximal humerus fracture on shoulder x-rays versus attending reference
links.effect: Sensitivity 61.8%, specificity 74.3%, overall accuracy 67.1%; 25.7% of normal x-rays misdiagnosed with fracture or dislocation; 23.5% of isolated PHFx read as normal.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 demonstrated a sensitivity of 61.8%, specificity of 74.3%, and an overall accuracy of 67.1% for PHFx x-rays.

links.outcome: Incorrect or missed diagnoses when general-purpose AI interprets radiographs
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 missed 23.5% of isolated PHFx x-rays as normal; inter-rater reliability with the attending was slight to poor for fracture characterization.
links.quote: ChatGPT incorrectly diagnosed 23.5% of isolated PHFx x-rays as normal, 8.8% with an isolated glenohumeral dislocation without fracture, and 5.7% with a PHFx dislocation.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing the diagnostic accuracy and interrater reliability of a multimodal LLM (ChatGPT-4o/5) against orthopedic surgeons for reading shoulder X-rays.
